blocks.text: Light microscope mein cheez ka image banane ke liye light (roshni) istemal hoti hai. Light pehle cheez mein se aur phir sheeshe ke do lenses mein se guzarti hai. Ek lens cheez ka bara image banata hai aur doosra lens us image ko aur bara kar deta hai. Is tarah dekhne wale ki aankh mein cheez ka bara aur saaf image banta hai.

blocks.alt: (a) Compound light microscope jis ke hisse label hain: eyepiece (ocular lens), arm, nosepiece, objective lens, stage par specimen, diaphragm, coarse adjustment, fine adjustment, light source aur base. (b) Kaam ka usool: light source ki roshni condenser, specimen, objective lens aur ocular lens se guzar kar dekhne wale (viewer) ki aankh tak pohanchti hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.2: (a) Light microscope ke bare hisse; (b) Light microscope ke kaam ka usool (textbook ki Figure 3.2 ke mutabiq asal drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Roshni neeche se oopar jati hai: light source, phir condenser (roshni ko specimen par jama karta hai), phir specimen, phir objective lens (pehli bari image), aur aakhir mein ocular lens (image ko mazeed bara karta hai). Coarse aur fine adjustment se focus theek hota hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 3.2(b) mein label 'Condensor' chhapa hai; sahi spelling 'Condenser' hai, aur drawing mein yahi likha gaya hai.

Light microscope ki magnification 1500X hai, yani yeh cheezon ko taqreeban 1500 guna bara kar sakta hai. Is ki resolving power (do qareeb nuqton ko alag dikhane ki had) 0.2 micrometre (µm) hai, aur 1 µm = 1/1000 mm. Yani light microscope 0.2 µm se chhoti cheezon ko alag alag nahi dikha sakta.

Light microscope zinda jandaron ko dekhne ke liye faida-mand hai. Lekin cells aam taur par transparent (shaffaf, aar-paar dikhne wale) hote hain, is liye un ke hisse tab tak alag nazar nahi aate jab tak unhen khaas stains (rang dene wale chemicals) se rang na diya jaye. Masla yeh hai ke staining aam taur par cells ko maar deti hai.
